mentioned.quote: Cyber: Risks of models assisting in the development, preparation, and/or execution of a cyber attack.

threshold.quote: Provides sufficient uplift with high impact cyber attacks for additional expected harm at severe scale.
threshold.note: Table 2.2.2.a, Cyber uplift level 1 (CCL); the table cell is split in the text layer, quote is the CCL definition.

response.quote: external deployments of a model take place only after the appropriate governance function determines the residual risk to be acceptable
response.note: E3 gate for misuse T/CCLs. No named safeguards are required: deployment mitigations 'may include' (p.10) and security levels are 'recommended' (p.11-12).

acc_decider.note: p.10/p.14 'the appropriate governance function' and p.16 'legal, compliance, and safety reviews with escalation procedures' name no role or body; p.17 'appropriate corporate governance bodies' unnamed.

acc_external.quote: we will assess the proximity of the model to the CCL and analyze the risk posed, involving internal and external experts as needed.
acc_external.note: Borderline: 'as needed' (E2) does not void; external experts take part in analysing the threshold. Other external references are hedged: 'Where appropriate, we may engage relevant external actors, including governments' p.6; 5.2 disclosures 'we aim to share' p.17.

acc_unmet.note: No statement of what happens if required safeguards cannot be met. p.10/p.14 only gate deployment on acceptable residual risk (E4); p.17 framework assessment says 'we may' update; no non-compliance procedure.
